name: @rolaca11/mcp-inspector
stderr:
Usage: mcp-inspector [options] [command]

CLI MCP client. Connect to stdio or HTTP MCP servers, run OAuth, discover
resources/tools/prompts/templates, call them, and request completions.

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  connect [options] <target>   Open an interactive REPL against a server
  discover [options] <target>  List server info, capabilities, resources,
                               templates, tools, and prompts
  resources                    Resource and resource-template operations
  skills                       Inspect MCP skills and their files
  tools                        Tool operations
  prompts                      Prompt operations
  complete [options] <target>  Request completion suggestions for a prompt
                               argument or a resource-template variable
  auth                         OAuth credential management for HTTP servers
  servers [options]            List named servers loaded from .mcp.json files in
                               cwd and home directory
  config                       Manage the inspector-level MCP server config
                               (/tmp/config/mcp-inspector/mcp.json)
  test [options] [paths...]    Run declarative YAML/JSON test suites against MCP
                               servers
  desktop [options]            Open the desktop app from the current directory
                               with the same server configuration as serve
  serve [options]              Start the web dashboard. Hosts the bundled UI at
                               / and the tRPC API at /api/trpc.
  help [command]               display help for command
